0022600100.text: The Pelicans (0-1, 12th in the West) are 3rd in the Southwest, 1 game back, and visit the Utah Jazz (0-1, 15th in the West) for their second game of the season. Utah is missing Jusuf Nurkic, who is out with a foot injury, while Tony Bradley (quadriceps) and Trey Alexander (knee) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions. New Orleans won the 2025-26 season series 3-0, including a 156-137 win in New Orleans on April 7, 2026, and the teams have not yet met in 2026-27.
